verdict.rationale: Docs mention traces can be 'filtered, exported, shared, and compared via the UI or API' and that LangSmith can be self-hosted, giving some data portability, but there is no documented full-account export in an open standard format (e.g., bulk JSON/CSV dump of all projects, datasets, evaluations) and a community comment notes needing a cloud account just to view your own traces, hinting at friction. missing for 10: comprehensive full-account export spec, explicit open-format guarantee (CSV/JSON schema), and independent confirmation that self-hosting removes all data lock-in.
